text:
marco: Follow-up after today's perf matrix: compaction still a big p99 contributor when run synchronously. Thinking about a "shaping-first" flow + explicit reclaim ack.
anya: shaping-first = ask batcher to coalesce small entries and return a "may_free" estimate, right? Lower risk than forcing compaction.
lee: Exactly. We saw shaping reduce pause by ~70% in microbench. Compaction still needed for deep fragmentation.
marco: Sketch of the handshake: 1) scheduler reads occupancy stream, 2) scheduler issues `POST /batcher/shaping?lane=...` -> quick response `shaped:true, est_freed=5`, 3) if not enough, scheduler `POST /batcher/reclaim` -> returns job_id, async ack when done with `freed_slots` and `credits_token`.
julia: Important: reclaim must be lease-scoped to avoid double-reclaim across hosts. Add `lease_token` on all requests.
anya: Also add `reserve_ms` on reclaim ack: batcher can hold freed slots for X ms as "reserved_for_scheduler" to prevent immediate reuse and races.
lee: Wire proto suggestion (text):
```
GET /batcher/occupancy -> {lane_id, occupancy, head_gap_ms, avg_req_tokens}
POST /batcher/shaping -> {lane_id, lease_token} => {shaped:bool, est_freed:int}
POST /batcher/reclaim -> {lane_id, lease_token, target:int, mode:async|sync} => {job_id}
POST /batcher/reclaim/ack -> {job_id} => {freed:int, credits_token:str, reserve_ms:int}
POST /scheduler/credits/claim -> {credits_token, amount}
```
marco: Note these blocks are bytes in the Slack thread (we'll put actual proto in RFC).
julia: Rollout: start with occupancy stream and shaping endpoint behind feature flag in canary. Leave reclaim disabled until we have robust retries.
anya: Observability: emit `reclaim.started`, `reclaim.progress`, `reclaim.finished` metrics with job_id tags. Also track `credits.latency` from ack -> scheduler claim.
lee: Edge: what if reclaim partially fails? Batcher should return partial `freed` and a retryable marker. Scheduler must accept partial refunds and adjust admission accordingly.
marco: Good. Also think about GC: long-running reclaim jobs should be cancelable by scheduler when lane ownership moves. `POST /batcher/reclaim/cancel?job=...&lease_token=...`. Batcher returns `cancelled:true|false`.
julia: devops-bot: canary plan queued: batcher-shape-v1 -> canary 5% us-east at 04:00 UTC. Healthchecks 15m.
anya: Perf plan: simulate 40k small requests/s with bursty arrivals and measure p50/p95/p99 tails before/after shaping. Also test cross-host lane transfer during reclaim.
lee: One more: credits bookkeeping. Use an immutable `credits_token` per reclaim ack to avoid double-spend. Scheduler redeems token once; batcher stores token->amount until TTL.
marco: OK action items: marco -> write RFC with proto + failure cases; anya -> telemetry + occupancy stream; lee -> perf harness scenarios; julia -> canary checklist. I'll post RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
